summary: Default intent-mode planning/execution model: /z-plan writes and audits a thin INTENT contract plus initial TASKS, /z-execute freezes it and advances BFS task levels with LEDGER checkpoints, and /z-review-all reviews INTENT.frozen.md plus LEDGER.

entry_points.summary: Validate frontmatter and required sections by intent level.
Set frozen_at back to pending for amended contracts.
Stamp frozen_at idempotently; reports FROZEN or ALREADY_FROZEN.
Create LEDGER.md frontmatter if absent without overwriting existing content.
Evaluate checklist criteria from INTENT, LEDGER citations, and cumulative diff.
Reads workflow.planning_mode and workflow.intent_level; intent path writes INTENT and initial TASKS.
--full forces legacy; --quick/--standard/--deep force intent levels and bypass classifier.
SPEC.md present -> legacy; INTENT.md present -> intent; neither -> halt.
Freeze INTENT and snapshot to archive/INTENT.frozen.md on first freeze.
Reads workflow.intent_bfs_level_cap and cost.token_budget; fallback cap is 6.
Generates BFS level N from frozen INTENT, LEDGER, unmet criteria, and prior outcomes.
Injects intent_snapshot and ledger_path into implementer/reviewer prompts.
Marks TASKS.md stale so task-tree-generator regenerates after an amended contract.

invariants: INTENT is frozen at execution boundary, not continuously mutable.
LEDGER is append-only audit trail for realized plan.
Task-tree levels are generated BFS; cross-level dependencies defer to later levels.
intent_snapshot and ledger_path are mandatory prompt signals in INTENT mode.
Unknown acceptance state counts as unmet.
workflow.intent_parallel_levels controls within-level sibling dispatch only.
gotchas: workflow.intent_bfs_level_cap is runtime-read and may not appear in DEFAULTS; empty/None falls back to 6.
stale_reason: amended-intent must replace any existing key, not duplicate it.
/z-do is now a lightweight route-down/deprecated shim toward quick planning.
Do not pass spec_path/plan_path to implementers in INTENT mode.

config_keys.workflow.hermes_enabled: bool master gate for Hermes machinery
